description:
Insert text at a specific line in a file.

- insert_line = 0: Insert at the beginning
- insert_line = N: Insert after line N
- insert_line = -1: Insert at the end
- insert_text should typically end with a newline
- Use absolute paths

insert_line.description: Line number to insert after (0 = beginning, -1 = end)

insert_text.description: Text to insert (should end with newline)

name: insert
title: Insert
